units.source_text: 我一走过去，夜风把燕子花的草丛吹得沙沙作响。

en.t: As soon as I walked over, the night wind made the clump of irises rustle.

units.source_text: 高高挂着的紫色花瓣，在轻轻的水声中震颤。

en.t: The purple petals hanging high trembled amid the gentle sound of water.

units.source_text: 那一带特别的黑，花儿的紫色、叶子的浓绿，看上去都是一片漆黑。

en.t: That area was especially dark; the purple of the flowers and the deep green of the leaves all looked pitch black.

units.source_text: 我想搞上二三枝燕子花。

en.t: I wanted to get two or three stems of iris.

units.source_text: 但是，花和叶沙沙作响，随风飘忽，从我的手里逃遁，一片叶子把我的手指划破了。

en.t: But the flowers and leaves rustled and drifted in the wind, slipping away from my hand, and one leaf cut my finger.
